blogs.title: Young Apostles Face Debibi United in First Regional Derby of GPL Season
blogs.author: Young Apostles FC
blogs.excerpt: Young Apostles FC will make the short trip to Derby Presby Park on Sunday for a Matchday 3 encounter against Debibi United FC in the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League. The fixture will mark the first regional derby involving Wenchi's top-flight representatives.
blogs.content:
WENCHI / DEBIBI — Young Apostles FC will make the short regional journey to Derby Presby Park on Sunday afternoon for a highly anticipated Matchday 3 encounter against Debibi United FC in the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League.

The fixture marks the first regional Bono derby of the campaign, with both sides eager to establish early dominance. Head Coach Abu Abdul-Hanan conducted an intensive tactical workout at the Wenchi Sports Stadium on Wednesday, focusing on midfield control and quick transitions.

"Derby matches demand composure, tactical discipline, and total commitment. We respect Debibi United, but our aim is to travel with authority and fight for all three points for our traveling supporters."
— Abu Abdul-Hanan, Head Coach

Kickoff is scheduled for Sunday at 3:00 PM GMT at Derby Presby Park. Live coverage and instant dispatches will be provided across all official Young Apostles FC media channels.

blogs.title: Samuel Prempeh Strike Earns Young Apostles First Win of the Season
blogs.author: Young Apostles FC
blogs.excerpt: Young Apostles FC secured their first victory of the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League season with a narrow 1-0 win over Basake Holy Stars in Wenchi. Samuel Prempeh provided the decisive moment, scoring early to give the home fans a landmark triumph.
blogs.content:
WENCHI — In front of a passionate, capacity home crowd at the Wenchi Sports Stadium, Young Apostles FC recorded their landmark first-ever Ghana Premier League victory on Sunday afternoon, edging Basake Holy Stars 1–0 on Matchday 2.

The decisive breakthrough came inside the opening seven minutes. Forward Samuel Prempeh chased down an incisive ball from midfield, beat two defenders with a slick first touch, and slotted coolly into the bottom right corner past the Holy Stars goalkeeper.

"This victory belongs to the good people of Wenchi who have supported us from Division Two, through Division One, and now onto the biggest stage in Ghana. The players showed relentless fighting spirit today."
— Abu Abdul-Hanan, Head Coach

Basake Holy Stars mounted several attacking waves in search of an equalizer during the second half, but the Apostles defensive backline stood firm, marshaled by exceptional positioning and goalkeeping.

The victory lifts Young Apostles to 8th on the official GPL standings table with 3 points, while preserving Wenchi as an impenetrable fortress for visiting opponents.

blogs.title: Season Opener: Apostles Fall 3-0 to Clinical Vision FC in Tema
blogs.author: Young Apostles FC
blogs.excerpt: Young Apostles kicked off their historic campaign at Nii Adjei Kraku Stadium, gaining vital top-flight experience despite opening day defeat.
blogs.content:
TEMA — Young Apostles FC began their maiden campaign in the top flight with an away test against Vision FC at the Nii Adjei Kraku II Sports Complex on Saturday afternoon.

The home side opened the scoring early in the 4th minute through Naziru Alhassan Nyenye before Setsofia Aqetey doubled the lead just before half-time (40') and added a third in the 68th minute.

Despite the scoreline, the Apostles created several promising chances in the second half, with the technical bench using the fixture to hand top-flight debuts to several young academy prospects.

blogs.title: Young Apostles Unveil 2026/27 Official Mayniak Matchwear Collection
blogs.author: Young Apostles FC
blogs.excerpt: The official Royal Blue & Gold home kit and white away strips are now available to fans worldwide via the online club shop.
blogs.content:
WENCHI — Young Apostles Football Club, in proud partnership with Mayniak Sportswear, is thrilled to present the official matchday kits for the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League season.

The home strip showcases the club's celebrated Royal Blue and Sunburst Gold, featuring bespoke geometric embossing inspired by traditional Bono cultural motifs. The away jersey is crafted in clean, pristine white with bold blue side panels.

Supporters can purchase authentic shirts with customized player names and numbers directly on our online store with mobile money checkout and nationwide delivery.
